author: Katherine Parks
text: Wonderful service! The guys were very professional and were so nice when my little one followed them around talking their ear off. I called in the morning and they were here a few hours later. Best company for any of your plumbing needs.

author: Blake Carter
text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
I can’t recommend him enough! Chapman went above and beyond from start to finish. was honest about what needed to be repaired, didn’t try to upsell unnecessary work, and pricing was more than fair.  Showed up on time, communicated throughout the job, and the quality of his work was outstanding. It’s hard to find a plumber who’s affordable, trustworthy, and genuinely cares about their customers, but they check every box. I’ll definitely be using them again and recommending them to family and friends.

author: Amber Green
text: Greatly appreciated the work that was done! He was very fast at scheduling my service, getting over to my house and getting the job done! and my washer works perfectly. I also didn’t have to pay anything as he was contracted through my home warranty Company.I highly recommend Hardin County plumbing service.

author: adam rickett
text: Have always had fast service and great work. Would definitely recommend them for all your plumbing needs

author: Charles Hinckley
text: I have used this company for many years. I have found them to be honest and efficient. I have used them to out in a septic system, repair problems and put in new sinks and water heaters. They are easy to work with and they show up when they say they will. I strongly recommend them.
